message:
fix(capture-lifecycle r1): the backend owner's log line no longer reads as a second 'session epoch='

1679bde logged each new session's backend as `session epoch=N backend requested=...`, next to the host's own
`session epoch=N peer=...` line -- anything counting 'session epoch=' (the keepalive standby e2e on top of it,
and log reading in general) counted every session twice. Now `backend-owner epoch=N requested=... active=...`.

Tests: host_capture_lifecycle_ua_e2e_test 46/46 rc0 (its needle follows the new name).

제품/테스트/문서: 제품(host 로그 한 줄 이름) / 테스트(UA e2e needle) / 문서(history)
